purpose: Provide a concrete GitHub repository mutation transport for QualifiedSourceMutationAdapter without weakening task scope, delegation, authority, lifecycle, audit, or effect-fence gates.

implementation.credentials: injected at runtime; never persisted by these components

mutation_algorithm: validate exact source mutation request schema and transport repository/ref identity
read current ref head and require exact expected_ref_head
read exact source and destination Git tree entries and enforce expected blob identity/absence
for WRITE_FILE create one blob and one tree update
for DELETE_FILE create one tree deletion
for MOVE_FILE create one tree containing source deletion and destination addition using the same source blob
create one commit whose only parent is expected_ref_head
re-read ref as advisory drift check
perform provider-side exact ref compare-and-swap using updateRefs beforeOid/afterOid
read back exact new ref head and mutated path/blob state
return SourceMutationTransportResult only after readback passes

persists: provider binding digest/request digest/authority subject/lifecycle permit digest
